data.name: Production Zero
data.detailed_description:
Control your factories at every scale

Production Zero’s 3-layer system allows you to have complete control over your factories: from small production units, to a full factory complex, to vast networks across multiple biomes. Each layer affects the others, so even small changes can have a huge impact.

Design once, use anywhere

Create templates of production units and even complete factories to scale your production with ease. Invest the time you saved on optimizing, automating, exploring, and growing your operations. 

Optimize with pinpoint precision

The flow diagnostics tool will give you real-time information on each aspect of your production process, like throughput, downtime, buffers and more. It will also warn you about minor and major issues before they happen. With all this information, it will be up to you to optimize your production lines and find your ideal balance between resiliency and efficiency. 

Be an expert and play your way

Our tech tree allows you to specialize in various aspects of the manufacturing process and play to your strengths. Become a logistics expert and run a distribution empire, invest in material science to build machines that can survive the harshest biomes, or chase new kinds of automation to increase your efficiency.

Enter The Garden

Generations ago, a mysterious meteor crashed into Earth. Humanity survived, but the impact transformed the surrounding region into a zone of extraordinary resource abundance - rare minerals, exotic materials, and unusual geological phenomena - called “The Garden.” The rest is up to you to uncover.

Choose wisely (because your choices matter)

In Production Zero, your interactions with the environment and the people around you have the potential to shape the future. Choose carefully who you work with and how you operate, and who knows? Maybe you will play an even bigger role than you think.

data.short_description: Production Zero is a factory building game in which you grow a manufacturing empire across an untamed world. Design vast networks of factories from top to bottom, extract unique resources, optimize & automate to achieve industrial harmony and scale your operation through varied biomes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5 3.4 GHz 4 Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
